title: Mark bounced Resend emails in your table
summary: When an email sent through Resend bounces or is marked as spam, note it on the customer's row and stop marketing to them.
description: Whenever an email you sent through Resend bounces, or the person marks it as spam, Taskiem finds them in your customers table by their address and sets their email status (bounced or complained). A complaint also turns their marketing_opt_in off, so no newsletter goes to them again.
